name: modKernel_embFin_mul
summary: Move the rational points to the infinite places by the invariance of the theta kernel, where they act by the real Weil representation on the Fock vector.

steps.claim: By the invariance of the theta kernel under rational points ((pairThetaKer ..).4 at (γ⁻¹, γ'⁻¹)), the left translations of the finite arguments become the action of (γ⁻¹, γ'⁻¹) at the infinite places; on the integrated datum this is the real Weil representation (pairWeil_integrated_all), which multiplies by the determinant characters of weights e, e' and substitutes into the Fock polynomial (realPairWeil_polyVector); simp evaluates the embeddings.
steps.lean:
h := by erw [modKernelI, modKernel, pairTheta, ← (pairThetaKer ..).4 ⟨γ⁻¹, rfl⟩ ⟨γ'⁻¹, rfl⟩,
  pairWeil_integrated_all, realPairWeil_polyVector, mul_one] <;> simp [↓stdSpace_ratEmbed_apply,
  embFin, modKernel, modDatum, pairTheta, ← map_det, ← mapMatrix_apply]
